learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover special words that add extra details to our action words!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If adjectives describe nouns, adverbs describe VERBS (action words)! They give us more information about the action happening in the sentence.
These adverbs tell us HOW an action is done. Did you run quickly or slowly? Did you sing loudly? Many of these words end in the letters 'ly'!
These adverbs tell us WHEN an action happens. Did you play yesterday, today, or tomorrow? Words like now, later, and soon are all adverbs of time.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The 'ly' Dance Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: Put on some music! Ask your parent to shout an adverb like slowly, quickly, or happily. You have to dance exactly how the adverb tells you to!

quick_recap: ⭐ Adverbs add meaning to action words (verbs).
⭐ They tell us HOW an action is done (quickly, neatly).
⭐ They tell us WHEN an action is done (today, yesterday).
